definitions.explanation: An entertainment facility with various arcade games including video games, crane games, rhythm games, and more.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}{帰|がえ}りにゲーセンに{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: I stopped by the arcade on the way home from school.

examples.japanese: ゲーセンでクレーンゲームをやった。
examples.english: I played a crane game at the arcade.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、ゲーセンが{減|へ}ってきている。
examples.english: Recently, arcades have been decreasing in number.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
ゲームセンター (game center) の{略|りゃく} - abbreviation of game center

COMMON GAMES:
・クレーンゲーム/UFOキャッチャー (crane/claw machine)
・{音|おと}ゲー (rhythm games)
・{格|かく}ゲー (fighting games)
・メダルゲーム (medal games)
・プリクラ (photo sticker booths)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese arcades (ゲーセン) are known for having the latest and most advanced arcade games. They remain popular despite the rise of home gaming, particularly for rhythm games and social experiences.
